newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder of wife.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder of wife.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Saturday beheaded a Saudi man for stabbing his wife to death, Saudi state-run radio monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) reported.
An interior ministry statement carried by the radio said the man stabbed his wife seven times while she was asleep with her seven children.
The beheading, in the town of Mehayel in the southern Aseer province, raised to 64 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
